assign.card: docs-vs-code-audit: do the docs add up with the code

assign.now: reading readme chain + Servex docs + ai docs

assign.title: Docs-vs-code audit: two stale MCP tool-count claims, one found-and-flagged name collision
assign.outcome:
**What landed**: checked 12 concrete claims from doc/systems-overview.md, doc/autonomy.md, todo.md and asks.jsonl against the live Servex + site MCP tool catalogs and the agent lifecycle code (Agents.js, tools.js). 9 held up exactly: dormant-agent lifecycle, the $2/$3 results-gated spend policy, spawn_agent's caller-as-parent default, the tool_results() logging gap (doc says it's unbuilt — confirmed still unbuilt), list_agents' unfiltered rows (todo.md already tracks it as open), the ~700 untracked files, and that ext/openrouter + ext/local are real code. 2 were stale and fixed directly in [doc/systems-overview.md](/framework/ai/doc/systems-overview.md#3a): the site MCP catalog was missing 7 research_* tools (said 5, live is 12); the Servex MCP catalog undercounted its own total (said 68, named only 52, live is 77) and was missing 22 real tools (ask_module, card_set, claim_topic, create_page, follow, register_session, and 16 more). Both fixes also drop the hardcoded counts in favor of a warning to check a live session's own tool list. One real doc gap — "heartbeat" names two unrelated mechanisms (doc/autonomy.md's session wakeup cron vs Servex/Heartbeat.js's task-owner pinger) — went on the board as a [Note card](/framework/ai/2026/10/07/docs-audit-heartbeat-means-two-different/) rather than a guessed fix, since picking which one gets renamed is the owner's call.

**Deliverables**: [claims.json](claims.json) (the full verdict list, script-computed counts), [report.md](report.md) (one screen), [generate-claims.mjs](generate-claims.mjs) (how each claim was checked). This is a backend/docs-only task — no page UI to screenshot or walk through.

**Deliberately left**: the Heartbeat.js/doc/autonomy.md name collision (owner's call, on the board); token-accounting and unbuilt-asks-from-prompts duplication was avoided per the brief (owned by task-mastermind-token-accounting and minion-prompt-audit respectively).
